shared_elements: animals rendered with legs and body in side view
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry carved quadruped animals seen largely from the side, which is about as generic as iconographic overlap gets. A depicts a horizontal narrative procession of human figures leading a humped camel, framed above and below by rosette bands, whereas B shows an animal in bold high relief clinging head-downward on a vertical pillar with a second flat, splayed animal below and no humans, patterned borders or narrative sequence at all.
